info.description: DesignBase is design intelligence for creators, not an image generator. POST /palette returns structured color palettes for a design brief (hex, name and role per color) with WCAG contrast ratios computed in code; POST /design-brief returns a structured design brief (concept, composition, typography direction, color direction, do/don't list); POST /image-prompt returns a production-ready image-generation prompt assembled in code from a prompt-grammar table (subject, composition, lighting, era lock, negative constraints); POST /critique takes an image upload and returns a structured critique with scored dimensions (composition, color harmony, legibility, focal point) and specific fixes. Hex values are validated in code and invalid values dropped, never repaired; contrast ratios are computed, not estimated. Critique scores are labeled model judgments. Every failure is a structured JSON error, including an explicit 503 when the reasoning engine is not configured.
info.title: DesignBase

post.description: Multipart form-data with one image file part (png, jpeg, gif or webp, detected from the file header; 8 MB cap) and an optional 'context' text field naming the intended use. Returns a summary, four scored dimensions (0-10 each, validated and clamped in code), an overall score, strengths, and specific fixes with priorities. The image format and dimensions in the response are read from the file header in code; the scores are labeled model judgments.

200.description: summary, scores {composition, color_harmony, legibility, focal_point} each {score, note}, overall_score, strengths[], fixes[] {issue, fix, priority}, image {filename, format, bytes, width, height}, judgment_source, _meta

401.description: Missing or invalid RapidAPI proxy secret

422.description: Structured error: invalid_body, missing_parameter, image_too_large or unsupported_format

post.summary: Critique an uploaded design (scored, with specific fixes)

post.description: JSON body: product, audience and vibe (all required). Returns a structured, executable design brief: concept direction, composition, typography direction (direction, headline, body), color direction (direction, notes), and concrete do/don't lists.

200.description: product, audience, vibe, brief {concept_direction, composition, typography {direction, headline, body}, color_direction {direction, notes}, dos[], donts[]}, _meta

401.description: Missing or invalid RapidAPI proxy secret

422.description: Structured error: missing_parameter, text_too_long or invalid_body

get.description: Service status, engine states (reasoning / prompt_builder / color_math), limits and recent request outcomes. Open at the origin (no proxy secret).

200.description: status, service, version, build, engines, limits, endpoints, recent_requests, note

post.description: JSON body: subject and style (required), era and product (optional). Assembled entirely in code from a written prompt-grammar table: no model call. Returns the production prompt, a negative prompt (no text, no lettering, no watermark, no distorted hands; anachronism negatives added when an era is given), the component breakdown showing exactly what the grammar added, and notes (including when a style matched no built-in preset). Works even while the reasoning engine is not configured.

200.description: prompt, negative_prompt, components {subject, style, medium, composition, lighting, era_lock?, product?}, notes[], _meta

401.description: Missing or invalid RapidAPI proxy secret

422.description: Structured error: missing_parameter, text_too_long or invalid_body

post.description: JSON body: brief (required, up to 2,000 characters), count (optional, default 3, cap 5). Returns that many distinct palettes; each color carries a code-validated #RRGGBB hex, a name and a role (primary, secondary, accent, background or text). Each palette carries a contrast block with WCAG 2.x ratios computed in code against its background color(s). Invalid hex values returned by the model are dropped and the drop count is reported in the validation field.

200.description: brief, palette_count, palettes[] {name, mood, colors[] {hex, name, role}, contrast {basis, pairs[]}}, validation {invalid_hex_dropped, note}, _meta

401.description: Missing or invalid RapidAPI proxy secret

422.description: Structured error: missing_parameter, text_too_long or invalid_body

post.summary: Get structured color palettes for a design brief
